name: Stark Power Ltd
summary: Stark Power Ltd is dedicated to engineering, marketing, and supporting sophisticated robotic cleaning systems that utilize cloud technology. These specialized systems are designed for maintaining solar panels and various infrastructure elements, with their services reaching Israel, India, and other global markets. Founded in 2013, the company is based in Ramat Gan, Israel, and adopted the name Stark Power Ltd in March 2026, having previously been known as E.E.A.M.I Ltd.
